input.rationale: Damage is isolated to the policyholder's own basement property, including structural elements (flooring, drywall) and personal property stored there, with no indication of third-party involvement or vehicle involvement.

Extensive water damage across the entire basement affecting multiple structural elements (buckled hardwood, soaked drywall up to one foot), plus loss of stored items. Repair and restoration costs will likely be substantial and exceed typical minor damage scenarios.

input.claim_summary: Basement flooding with approximately 2 inches of water across entire basement. Hardwood flooring buckled, drywall soaked up to 1 foot, and stored boxes ruined. Discovered upon claimant's return from work trip. High-severity property damage claim requiring structural assessment and contents evaluation. Deductible: $500; Coverage Limit: $750,000.
